markets.rules_secondary: Laws passed by New York State are encompassed within the Payout Criterion if they apply to or govern New York City. Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law. For standard legislation requiring executive approval, this includes final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods. For legislation not requiring executive approval, this includes final passage and completion of required waiting periods. For constitutional amendments, this includes passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes. For executive orders, this includes official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness. Legislative passage without completed executive action, passage by only some required bodies, provisional passage, non-binding resolutions, and draft orders do not constitute enactment. Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

markets.rules_primary: If Benjamin Netanyahu has been arrested before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, "arrested" means:
Being taken into physical custody by law enforcement authorities (including federal, state, local, military, or international law enforcement)
Voluntarily surrendering to law enforcement authorities in response to an arrest warrant
Being formally booked or processed following detention

The following scenarios would satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Benjamin Netanyahu is handcuffed and taken to a police station
Benjamin Netanyahu surrenders at a police station or courthouse with their attorney
Benjamin Netanyahu is arrested in any country and this is reported by a Source Agency
Benjamin Netanyahu is detained at an airport or border crossing and formally arrested

The following scenarios would NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An arrest warrant being issued but not executed
Benjamin Netanyahu being briefly detained but not arrested
Benjamin Netanyahu being questioned or interviewed without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being placed under house arrest or electronic monitoring without physical custody
Benjamin Netanyahu being named in an indictment without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being arrested after Nov 1, 2026
Protective custody that is not an arrest
markets.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be arrested before Nov 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Ken Martin leaves as chair of the Democratic National Committee before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Ken Martin must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Ken Martin be out as chair of the Democratic National Committee before Dec 1, 2026?
